What's the duplicate key — webhook's own event ID (if the provider sends one), a hash of the payload, or something time-windowed like same type+resource within N seconds? Those are different implementations, not just detail — event ID assumes the provider guarantees uniqueness/redelivery semantics, payload hash catches retries with identical bodies but not near-identical ones, time-window catches neither cleanly but handles providers with no ID at all.

Need to know which webhook source(s) this covers before I pick one.
